lesson-intro.text: The sun is the easiest thing in the sky to draw: one circle and eight straight rays. Watch the rays go around like a clock, then light up your own page.

left-half.text: The sun is a big circle. From the top, curve around the left side down to the bottom.

right-half.text: Now close the circle. From the top again, curve around the right side.

rays-up-down.text: Rays are short straight lines. Draw one above the sun and one below, not touching it.

rays-sides.text: Next, one ray on the left and one on the right.

rays-corners.text: Four more rays fit in the gaps, slanting out like an X.

lesson-outro.text: Eight rays and a big yellow middle. Your page just got warmer.
